authoredNote: Source written first from the #866 pre-declared contract (java/groovy already satisfied it; scala was measured to drop the member). The expectation was recorded from the post-fix run only to get the spelling of kind/owner and the exact call lines right — the contract itself is the issue's, not the run's.
rationale: M49/M37 #866: `val field` inside `new Runnable { ... }` was dropped entirely — handleVariable's ancestor scan breaks only on class_definition/trait_definition/object_definition/enum_definition, and an anonymous body's `template_body` is not one of them, so the scan reached the enclosing `def` and reclassified the member as a function-local. It is now emitted with ownerName=anonymous_Runnable (kind `constant`, scala's existing val/var kind convention at class level too — see handleVariable: `val` is Constant in this language regardless of scope, so the kind here is the language's own convention and NOT part of the #866 divergence). The initialiser's call attribution was already correct in scala and is pinned so the two halves cannot drift apart. The `local` control pins the OTHER half of the same boundary: a method-local is not a project symbol. Call lines are pinned because the `local` call in build() is legitimately attributed to build.
